response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, n AS qc_record_count, CAST(n AS REAL) / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(n AS REAL) / AVG(n) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM g

assumptions.assumption: A missing funding source means NULL fundflux only, grouped together as one group. Empty strings, if any, stay in their own group.
The average per funding source is the mean of the group counts across all groups, including the NULL group.
Values are returned as unrounded floating-point numbers.
